Sections are adapted (extracted and stripped of formatting); some are machine-translated from the page in the other language (Italian or English) with Helsinki-NLP\'s opus-mt-tc-big models. The adapted and translated text is also licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0

Text by Wikipedia contributors, linked in the guide\'s sources: the History (shortened) and Climate sections of each city\'s article and the sections on cuisine, traditions, media and telecommunications of each region\'s article. When History or Climate is missing or thin, it is machine-translated from the article in the other language, as for Wikivoyage. The adapted and translated text is also licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0

resources.string: Summary of your choices, which can be changed at any time from More
No download started: countries can be added from the Countries tab
Turned on in More, Settings, with a model on the device or an API key
The AI assistant has two engines

\"On device\" works even without internet: a small model downloaded to the device (requires at least 3 GB of RAM) answers using the guide and your personal notes. \"Online\" uses a service of your choice (ChatGPT, Mistral, Gemini or Claude) with your own API key, which stays on the device
Passports, tickets and other documents are protected by biometrics and never sent off the device
Embassies, ministries and WHO open in a browser tab and require a connection: the app never saves them offline, so they stay up to date

The catalog lists the countries, maps and guides that can be downloaded. Anyone who publishes their own data with the Pocket Travel pipeline can enter their catalog here, with the public key that verifies its signature. The catalog is tested before it is used; then the app restarts
Use only a catalog you trust: it decides which data the app downloads and receives its requests
The address must be complete and start with https://
Invalid public key: an ECDSA P-256 key in base64 is required
Catalog or signature not reachable. Check the address and the connection
The catalog signature does not match the public key
The signed file is not a Pocket Travel catalog
On arrival at the destination, navigation closes automatically, even with the app in the background, to save battery. With this option off, navigation stays active until it is closed
A light vibration at each turn and two on arrival, to follow navigation without looking at the screen
With a connection, about every hour: orange and red alerts and tsunamis in the installed regions
Catalog unreachable: only the countries already downloaded are shown
